note: Recast from entry 52 (pp. 360–364) of Roonwal and Chhotani (1997), the original in English; alate, soldier and pseudoworker are recorded, the pseudoworker being placed in the Worker section. The synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type specimens and distribution data of the original are not entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate head, thorax, wing scales, femora and abdomen deep chestnut brown, the sternites paler; body length (without wings) 5.70 mm, head length (to the mandibular base) 1.05 mm, width 1.08 mm. Anterior part of the soldier head capsule brown to dark reddish brown, the sides converging in front of the antennal bases and then produced into horn-like processes; body length about 5.60–7.30 mm, head length (to the mandibular base) 1.60–1.80 mm, width 1.30–1.50 mm; left mandible length 1.15–1.25 mm, its apical half with 2 large, nearly triangular teeth and its base with 1–2 small serrations; postmentum rod-like, median length 0.93–1.08 mm, greatest width 0.38–0.50 mm, least width 0.15–0.25 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax, wing scales, femora and abdomen deep chestnut brown, the sternites paler; antennae, base of the mandibles, labrum and legs yellowish brown. Head hairs sparse, body hairs moderate. Body length (without wings) 5.70 mm. Head capsule nearly circular (head length to the mandibular base 1.05 mm, width 1.08 mm), the sides slightly convex, the posterior part rounded; cranial sutures invisible. Antenna with more than 8 segments, segment 4 the shortest. Compound eyes nearly oval (greatest diameter 0.35 mm, least diameter 0.28 mm), closely applied to the antennal sockets. Ocelli white, semitransparent, small, oval (greatest diameter 0.08 mm, least diameter 0.06 mm), almost touching the compound eyes. Anteclypeus white, hairless, with a weak point in the middle; postclypeus trapezoidal, not clearly separated from the frons. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long, the anterior margin broadly rounded, with several stout hairs near the anterior margin. Pronotum flat, nearly rectangular, far wider than long and as wide as the head (width 1.08 mm, length 0.80 mm); anterior margin concave, the sides sloping down to a nearly straight posterior margin with a faint median notch. Forewing scale large, covering the hindwing scale. Legs short, the femora swollen; tibial apical spur formula 3:3:3; abdomen nearly cylindrical, cerci 2-segmented, 0.05 mm long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior part of the head capsule brown to dark reddish brown, the posterior part paler; antennae golden yellow, the basal segments heavily sclerotized and dark; labrum semitransparent, white; mandibles blackish brown, paler at the base; pronotum light brown; abdomen and legs yellow. Head hairs sparse, body hairs moderate. Body length about 5.60–7.30 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, far longer than wide (head length to the mandibular base 1.60–1.80 mm, width 1.30–1.50 mm); the sides nearly straight, converging in front of the antennal bases and then produced laterally into horn-like processes (extensions of the ventral genae); frons sloping forward, separated from the vertex by a distinct ridge that is depressed in the middle, forming a short shallow groove; cranial sutures distinct; posterior margin broadly rounded. Compound eyes close to the antennae, small, oval (greatest diameter 0.15–0.20 mm, least diameter 0.05–0.13 mm), semitransparent; no ocelli. Antenna 9–12 segments, with moderate hairs, segment 4 the shortest. Anteclypeus thin, narrow, semitransparent; postclypeus trapezoidal, not clearly separated from the frons. Labrum nearly rectangular, far wider than long, the anterior margin faintly pointed in the middle. Mandibles long (left mandible 1.15–1.25 mm), about 2/3 of the head length (to the mandibular base), stout, the apex pointed and curved inward, the outer margin with a swelling near the base; the apical half of the left mandible with 2 large, nearly triangular teeth and the base with 1–2 small serrations; the right mandible with 2 large, nearly triangular teeth, one in the middle and one on the basal half. Postmentum rod-like, widest at the proximal 1/3, then with a narrow waist before widening again towards the base (median length 0.93–1.08 mm, greatest width 0.38–0.50 mm, least width 0.15–0.25 mm). Pronotum flat, nearly kidney-shaped, with a translucent median line, far wider than long (width 1.05–1.28 mm, length 0.60–0.80 mm), slightly narrower than the head; anterior margin concave, posterior margin nearly straight. Legs short, the femora stout, swollen and dark; tibial apical spur formula 3:3:3; abdomen long-oval and hairy, cerci 2-segmented, 0.10–0.13 mm long, styli one-segmented, 0.08 mm long.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Recorded in the original as a pseudoworker. Head capsule, antennae, labrum, clypeus, pronotum and legs creamy white to pale yellow; body pale yellowish white to dirty white. Head hairs moderate, body hairs fairly dense. Body length about 4.25–5.50 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, slightly wider than long (width 0.98–1.18 mm, head length to the mandibular base 0.85–1.10 mm). Compound eyes white to pale brown, small, oval. Antenna 11–12 segments, short, segment 4 the shortest. Labrum wider than long, broadly lingulate, the anterior margin convex. Pronotum flat, nearly rectangular, far wider than long (width 0.78–1.00 mm, length 0.50–0.63 mm), narrower than the head; anterior margin slightly concave, the sides bent down to a nearly straight posterior margin with a faint median notch.
